title: Each element as a grandparent
caption:
Grandparents come in four elements, and every family has a favourite story about theirs.

Air knows every neighbour and video-calls daily. Fire runs the family calendar and has already booked the summer trip. Water has the calmest lap in the house. Earth has kept every drawing you ever made.

Grandparents: which one are you? Comment your element. Everyone else: send this to yours, and help them take the test.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
